title: Recursive Globbing and &&
description:
Two useful features in the shell:

1. `**` (recursive globbing)
This matches files in all subdirectories, but only if enabled with:
`shopt -s globstar`

Example:
- `ls **/*.txt` finds all .txt files recursively

2. `&&` (command chaining)
This runs the next command ONLY if the previous one succeeds.

Example:
- `mkdir test && cd test`

---
